messages.author: bcfb6bc9f75aae0f
messages.subject: What is new in (R)stan 2.13.1 ?
parts:
Dear list,

Something called rstan-2.13.1 has hit CRAN between yesterday and this morning. As usual, there seems to be no documentation of what has changed between 2.12 and 2.13...

Hence the usual question : what has changed ?

--
Emmanuel Charpentier

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: What is new in (R)stan 2.13.1 ?
parts:
On Monday, December 19, 2016 at 8:07:14 AM UTC-5, Emmanuel Charpentier wrote:
Something called rstan-2.13.1 has hit CRAN between yesterday and this morning. As usual, there seems to be no documentation of what has changed between 2.12 and 2.13...

Hence the usual question : what has changed ?
As usual, we don't announce it until there are widespread binaries and as usual there is a NEWS file on the CRAN webpage, in the source file, and available via news(package = "rstan").

messages.author: bcfb6bc9f75aae0f
messages.subject: Re: What is new in (R)stan 2.13.1 ?
parts:
Thank you very much.

I jus wonder why this NEWS file isn't part of the package...

--
Emmanuel Charpentier
